title: Clo Summit New York 2025 🗽
description:
Enjoy the highlights from the CLO Summit New York this year - our biggest US event to date! This year's theme was "Blueprint for Success", focusing on practical strategies for 3D adoption. We were thrilled to welcome over 300 industry professionals and see many familiar faces. 
Thank you to everyone who attended - we look forward to seeing you next year!
transcript: It's the one time a year that our team really hunkers down and gets a lot of stuff done together. They pull all-nighters, it kind of feels like going back to college again. And then we release this great product to create a community with all of our users and it's just such a great feeling to see everyone here and the energy is really high. I've been at my company for about a year and we just started implementing processes. So to hear from people who have been in it for five to seven years who have actually gone through this, it's really helpful for us to say, okay maybe we should do that, maybe we should try this. We love hearing feedback and thoughts directly from users. We also like hearing what they really liked and also what they want improved. Seeing how everybody's using the software really quickly and easily from everyone and just getting like a lot of opinions at once. My favorite thing about this summit is that we get to see all of our clients recognize each other from last year and kind of trade tricks and tools that they've learned over the years. There's so much excitement with all of like the new features within Clo. So definitely diving into it like once we get back, figuring out how can we apply this to our current workflow and learning from there. We're super excited. There was so much great content today. How can we improve our processes inside our brands? We live in a huge bubble of enterprises and fashion business. We don't actually look around that much. So being here, sharing with Nike, talking with Ibram Kroby, chatting with the Hugo Boss, VP of supply chains, really helped me visualize how big can this be. How big can we go with 3D technology, with DPC, inside Pharma and other brands and actually opened my eyes to we need to fast-track our development. Clo has so much more potential than we realize and the foundations we lay today we can't even imagine yet where it can go in the future and I think there's more than what we're currently seeing. Clo really cares about their users opinions and that you are open for our feedback and I feel like that's what we're going for. Clo really cares about their users opinions and that you are open for our feedback and I feel like that's what we're going for. that's what makes this relationship and the software so successful and so useful. I love the company, I believe in Clow, and I think it's definitely the future.
markdown_content: ## Clo Summit New York 2025 Overview This section covers the collaborative environment and user engagement at the Clo Summit, highlighting the importance of community, feedback, and shared learning among users and the Clo team. Key terms include user feedback, community building, product development, and collaborative workflows. The Clo Summit is an annual event where the team intensively collaborates to develop and release new product features, fostering a strong community among users. The event atmosphere is highly energetic, resembling a collegiate all-nighter, emphasizing teamwork and creativity. Attendees benefit from networking, exchanging tips, and learning from each other's experiences with the software. This interaction helps both new and seasoned users optimize their workflows and implement best practices. ## User Feedback and Process Implementation This section focuses on how feedback from experienced users influences process improvement and feature adoption at Clo. Important concepts include process implementation, user feedback, feature adoption, and workflow optimization. Many attendees have been using Clo for five to seven years, providing valuable insights into effective processes and strategies. Newer users, including those who have been with the company for about a year, find this exchange critical for deciding which processes to adopt or adjust. The Clo team actively listens to user feedback, both positive and critical, to refine the product. This direct dialogue helps prioritize development efforts and ensures the software evolves in ways that meet real user needs. ## Networking and Knowledge Sharing Among Clients This section describes the networking aspect of the summit where clients share practical knowledge and tips, enhancing collective expertise. Relevant terms include client networking, knowledge sharing, user community, and feature exploration. One of the summit's highlights is seeing returning clients reconnect and share tricks and tools they have discovered using Clo over the years. This peer-to-peer learning accelerates adoption of new features and encourages creative applications. The excitement around recently released Clo features motivates attendees to explore how these can be integrated into their current workflows, promoting continuous learning and improvement. ## Industry Insights and Expansion Potential of Clo Technology This section explores insights gained from cross-industry interactions and the future potential of Clo’s 3D technology. Key terminology includes 3D technology, DPC (digital product creation), supply chain management, and industry expansion. Participants expressed appreciation for exposure to diverse industries such as enterprise fashion, pharma, and supply chain management by engaging with representatives from brands like Nike and Hugo Boss. Conversations with industry leaders, including Ibram Kroby and the VP of Supply Chains at Hugo Boss, helped attendees grasp the scale and versatility of 3D technology and digital product creation (DPC). These insights underscored the need to accelerate development efforts to fully realize Clo’s potential across various sectors beyond fashion. ## Commitment to User-Centric Development and Future Vision This section highlights Clo’s dedication to user-driven development and the long-term vision for the software. Important terms include user-centric development, software evolution, feedback loops, and future potential. Clo emphasizes its commitment to incorporating user feedback, fostering an open and collaborative relationship with its community. This responsiveness is seen as a key factor in the software’s success and utility. Attendees expressed strong belief in Clo’s vision, recognizing that the foundation being built today will enable innovations that are currently unimaginable. The company’s openness to feedback and focus on user needs position Clo as a future leader in digital product creation technology.
